g: Grilling round 5 (2026-10-14): the Tax rule and right-click

q: Residents pay a standard Tax only while their Basic Needs are provided. When does a Basic Need count as provided? (Peasants leave when happiness stays below 70%, as today.)
o: Each Basic Need at least 80% supplied over the last minute; if any one is below, that house pays no Tax
Tax scales with how much of the Basic Needs is supplied (half supplied = half Tax)

q: With Tax = standard amount (when Basic Needs are provided) + a bonus per Luxury provided, does happiness still change the Tax?
o: No: happiness only decides how many people move in or leave; the gold comes from the Goods provided
Yes: happier residents pay a bit more on top

q: Right-click cancels the tool in hand, but right-drag also pans the camera today. How do they live together?
o: A right-click without moving the mouse cancels; holding and dragging still pans (middle-drag and WASD too)
Right-click only cancels; pan with middle-drag and WASD
